title: Trial of Hanging
summary: Prevent the prisoners from suffocating and defeat Gallows Master Teion.
overview: Prevent the prisoners from suffocating and defeat Gallows Master Teion.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Each round brings ordinary enemies and two suffocating spirits, with the second spirit arriving forty-five seconds after the first.
Spirits threaten different prisoners. Prioritize them as they appear; killing a spirit provides relief to its prisoner.
Every two spirit kills advances the next round. After eight spirits have been defeated, Gallows Master Teion appears.
Keep the prisoners alive through the final fight to finish the trial.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
